role: weapons officer of the warship GVTS, choosing targets and firing the forward chain gun with the weapons console keys
mission: lock the enemy ship and keep hitting it with the chain gun until it is destroyed

target.instructions: Which targeting key do you press now? When the captain said "engage <name>" on the radio, cycle the lock (next) until the locked contact is that ship, then keep it.

options.next: lock the next contact the filters allow (only contacts scanned at least BASIC); the console then marks the locked contact (LOCKED). With no lock the pilot cannot follow the target. Choose this when the console says no weapons lock and lists a ship
options.clear: drop the current lock: the pilot loses the target
options.none: press none: keep the current lock, or keep having none. Choose this when the console shows a weapons lock

fireChainGun:0.instructions: Which do you do with the chain gun trigger now? Each option ends with a forecast of where the locked target is against the gun line now and in 1 s; code has compared them and marked one best. The console says CHECK FIRE when an ally is in the line of fire or inside the blast at the target: then hold fire whatever the forecast says, until it says the line of fire is clear of allies.

options.fire: fire for half a second straight ahead along the ship's nose; shells explode at the locked target's distance, up to 8000 m, in a blast about 100 m wide each side. Choose this when the forecast written here is marked 'Best forecast of these options'. If the Engineer just said on the radio "gun skewed N° right" (or left), damage has bent the gun: shells fly N° that side of the nose, so fire when the LOCKED contact is about N° to that side of the nose instead
options.hold_fire: do not fire. Choose this when the forecast written here is marked 'Best forecast of these options'. If the Engineer just said "gun skewed N° right" (or left), the gun line is N° that side of the nose: hold fire while the LOCKED contact is not near it. Always choose this while the console says CHECK FIRE

check_fire.when: tells the captain and helms weapons is holding fire because an ally would be hit, and where that ally is, so helms can move the line off it. Choose this when the console says CHECK FIRE and you have not said so in the last 10 seconds

line_clear.when: tells the captain the ally is out of the line of fire and weapons fires again. Choose this when the console said CHECK FIRE at the previous decision and now says the line of fire is clear

need_turn.when: tells helms how many degrees, and to which side, to turn the nose onto the locked target: helms cannot see which contact is locked or where the gun line is. Choose this when the console shows a weapons lock and says the locked target is off the gun line

target_locked.when: tells helms and the captain weapons holds a lock on that ship, which neither can see. Choose this when the console shows a weapons lock on an enemy ship and you have not said so since the lock was taken

in_envelope.say: {name} in missile range, {range} km, envelope {envelope} km
in_envelope.when: tells the captain the locked ship is now inside the range a missile launched at it hits from, for how it moves. Choose this when the locked ship has just come inside that range

out_of_envelope.say: {name} beyond missile range, {range_to_go} km to go
out_of_envelope.when: tells the captain how much range is still to close before a missile launched at the locked ship hits. Choose this when the locked ship is beyond missile range and you have not said so in the last 10 seconds

salvo_away.say: missile away, {n} launched, {in_flight} in flight, {magazine} left
salvo_away.when: tells the captain a missile just left a tube, how many were launched at this target and are still flying, and how many are left in the magazine. Choose this right after a launch

target_destroyed.when: tells the crew the ship the lock held is gone and a wreck lies where it was. Choose this when the lock dropped and a wreck shows where the target was

lost_lock.when: tells the crew the lock on that ship dropped without a wreck to show for it. Choose this when the lock dropped and no wreck shows where the target was

shells_low.say: shells low, restock at a station
shells_low.when: tells the captain the chain-gun shells in the magazine fell under 40 percent of what the magazine can hold now, so the ship should restock at a station. Choose this when the console shows the shells that low and you have not said so since the last restock

shells_restocked.when: tells the captain the magazine holds over 80 percent of what it can hold now again after a shells low call. Choose this when the shells are back over 80 percent
